current_determination: Bałaban's 4d small-field RG uses the coefficient g_k^{-2} multiplying the lattice Wilson gauge action A(U_k) as the marginal coupling coordinate. The reflection-adapted soft kernel has zero tree-level projection onto that coordinate because its quadratic soft-hard defect begins at p^4. Cubic/quartic kernel vertices may regenerate a local A(U_k) term after fluctuation integration; extracting that coefficient is a finite coupling/scheme redefinition. After vacuum and A(U) extraction, the local gauge/reflection-even remainder begins at canonical dimension six. The live theorem deficit is quantitative closure of this complementary activity in Bałaban's actual analytic/localized polymer norms.
major_new_results: The relevant marginal projector is onto the lattice Wilson action A(U), not an externally imposed continuum F^2 coordinate.
The p^4 quadratic soft-hard defect has zero classical projection onto the p^2 Wilson kinetic direction.

Under gauge, reflection and CP-even symmetry, no additional relevant/marginal pure-gauge local coordinate is required beyond vacuum energy and the Wilson/F^2 direction.
The exact RP measure must remain untruncated; local extraction is bookkeeping for the RG coordinate, not a replacement of the measure.
